question.prompt: Name a space-themed cartoon, animated film, or children's TV show.
question.criteria: Any released animated film, animated series, or children's television series with outer space, space travel, or life on other planets as a central theme.

answers.evidence: WALL-E is a Pixar animated film in which a waste-collecting robot travels into space.
Futurama is an animated comedy about a delivery crew whose work takes them across space.
Lightyear is a Pixar animated science-fiction film about space ranger Buzz Lightyear.
Treasure Planet is a Disney animated film that reimagines Treasure Island as an adventure through space.
Star Wars: The Clone Wars is an animated series following conflicts across the Star Wars galaxy.
Star Wars Rebels is an animated series about a rebel spaceship crew opposing the Galactic Empire.
Duck Dodgers is an animated series featuring Daffy Duck as a space adventurer.
Space Ghost is an animated superhero series about a masked hero fighting villains in outer space.
Clangers is a stop-motion children's series about creatures living on a small planet.
Ready Jet Go! is an animated children's series about an alien boy and his friends exploring space and science.
Miles from Tomorrowland is an animated children's series about a boy and his family having adventures in space.
Lloyd in Space is an animated series about an alien teenager living on a space station.
Wander Over Yonder is an animated series about a cheerful traveler and his companion exploring the galaxy.
Final Space is an animated science-fiction series about an astronaut and an alien named Mooncake.
Ulysses 31 is an animated series that reimagines Greek mythology as a space adventure.
Space Racers is an animated preschool series about young spacecraft exploring the solar system.
Astroblast! is an animated children's series about animal friends running a smoothie cafe in space.
Star Trek: Lower Decks is an animated comedy about junior officers aboard a Starfleet ship.
Star Trek: Prodigy is an animated series about young aliens who discover a Starfleet ship.
Button Moon is a children's puppet series about Mr Spoon's rocket journeys to Button Moon.
Captain Star is an animated science-fiction comedy about a spaceship crew stationed on a remote planet.
Rick and Morty is an animated series featuring frequent adventures on alien planets and across dimensions.
Lilo & Stitch is an animated film about a Hawaiian girl who befriends an alien experiment.
Invader Zim is an animated series about an alien sent to conquer Earth.
Buzz Lightyear of Star Command is an animated series about Buzz and his fellow space rangers.
The Zula Patrol is an animated children's series about aliens exploring science and space.

question.explanation: Space-themed animation and children's television range from interplanetary adventures and science-fiction comedies to puppet shows set among the stars.
